name: Watchfire
line: A BBS-style door game on the beacons.gg network: three logs a day to keep fires burning at real places around the world.
descriptionMd:
Watchfire is a door game in the spirit of the old bulletin boards, played in your terminal. Fires burn at real places around the world: a lantern on a hill in Edinburgh, a brazier in Shibuya, a fire in Hell, Norway. Every day you get three logs. Lay them on the fires you care about, light new ones where you are, and come back tomorrow to see what survived the night.

A visit takes about a minute.

## Fires live because strangers chose them

A fire burns for half a day on its own, and every log keeps it going four hours longer. You can't keep a fire alive by yourself for long, so the fires that last are the ones other people chose too. Lay a log and you become one of its keepers.

Even the best-kept fire goes dark within 60 hours, so the world keeps turning over and someone always has to light the next one.

## Embers and ashes

Once a fire holds five logs, each of its keepers can take an ember, a keepsake from that place. When a fire goes dark, its keepers rake the ashes for their logs, charred black, and a cinder still warm.

## The watch log

Every visit starts with the news: which fires were lit, which were fed, which reached five logs and which went dark while you were away. The fires nearest you are on the main screen, and the whole world is a keypress away.

## Warm your hands

Anyone can stop at a burning fire and warm their hands, even players of other games on the beacons.gg network. Elsewhere brings Watchfire's fires into its world, where travellers warm up and hang a pot over the flames.

## Getting started

Play over SSH at a door, with nothing to install, or run the game for Linux, macOS or Windows in your own terminal. Your SSH key is your keeper. Tell the game where you keep watch (any town of 1,000 people or more, or a latitude and longitude) and it shows the fires nearest you.

Every door also serves a website with a live map of the world's fires, the ones closest to going out, and the watch log.

Watchfire runs on the beacons.gg network. Each fire is a Beacon room, and the server enforces its rules, so there's no game server to trust. Play on any server that admits Watchfire, or run a door of your own.

interop.note: Watchfire's fires show up in Elsewhere. Its players can warm their hands at a burning fire, and the warmth counts in Watchfire.
